title: Policy
description: A rule of the organization, written as a sentence by a person and kept as a Cedar rule (doctrine D-058, spec 112). It decides what may be done at all (authority), or what needs someone's approval (approval). A new one observes first (trial): its decisions are journaled, never enforced. Each change is a new version.

sentence.description: The policy as the organization says it: « Un agent n'écrit pas aux clients après 19 h ».

rule.description: Its Cedar rule: one permit or forbid.

set.description: authority: a forbid refuses, a permit allows. approval: a permit means the gesture needs the approver's approval.

approver.description: Who approves, for an approval policy: a relation or a role the product resolves (manager, project.holder, direction, on_behalf_of).

owner.description: Who answers for it: a person's id.

status.description: active: enforced. trial: observed, never enforced. off: kept, not read.
